synopsis: Chapter 11 identifies MathWorks RoadRunner, RoadRunner Scene Builder and RoadRunner Scenario as commercial environment-creation tools that build and edit 3D environments, import GIS, HD maps and point clouds, reconstruct recorded scenes and parameterize scenarios [f8358, f8605, f9152]. The glossary reinforces their map and point-cloud import capabilities and exports to CARLA, dSPACE and IPG CarMaker; Chapter 11 specifies dSPACE ASM and lists OpenDRIVE, OpenSCENARIO, USD, FBX and glTF, with gRPC additionally listed among interfaces and standards [f15999, f8606, f9154]. They are adaptable to off-road use, but the base editor remains road-oriented, a limitation repeated in the glossary [f9153, f15999]. Pricing requires a quote, and only an unofficial price list was found; the latest release found was R2026b [f9155, f9156].

relations.note: Adds GIS, HD maps, recorded-scene reconstruction and scenario parameterization to glossary import capabilities.
Specifies dSPACE ASM and export formats for the glossary's export destinations.
Adds off-road adaptability to the shared road-oriented editor limitation.
Details environment creation and reconstruction capabilities of the listed MathWorks tools.
Identifies the listed RoadRunner tools as commercial offerings.
Repeats five listed formats and adds gRPC among interfaces and standards.
Adds quote-based pricing and the absence of an official price list to commercial status.
